learning_outcomes: Recognise and sketch y = ax^n for n = −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3 and simple sums of these
Identify and state the coordinates of turning points, intercepts and asymptotes
Sketch and interpret graphs of the form y = ab^x (exponential growth and decay)
Use a graph to solve an equation by reading off intersection points
Sketch the graph of a function after a given transformation (translation, stretch)
